definitions.latest: Publishedの新しい順。Published同値はFirst Seenの新しい順。
definitions.hottest: 直近30日Publishedの記事を現在Heatの高い順。
definitions.rising: Heat履歴2点以上・6時間以上のspanが揃った記事を対象に、直近24時間のHeat上昇率で算出。
definitions.persistent_hot: Heat履歴3点以上・48時間以上のspanが揃った記事を対象に、各時点で上位10%を80%以上維持した記事。

latest.summary: Since mid-August 2026, a phishing operation has been stealing live Google sessions from corporate users. Every check defenders normally lean on to judge a link came back clean, and the operator designed it that way on purpose. The Threat Research team at Material Security spotted the campaign and has since taken down hundreds of attacker domains in an effort the team calls Operation CloudFire.
